verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents its own soundbite capability: an MCP tool, fireflies_create_soundbite, creates a clip from a meeting transcript, and the MCP tools overview lists creating soundbites as an action. However, the evidence documents sharing only for whole meeting transcripts, not for an individual clip. Missing for 10: documented sharing of a soundbite or highlight in place of the full recording, in-app (non-MCP) clip creation docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a sales lead, I can cut a soundbite or highlight clip from a call and share that moment instead of the whole recording

citations.quote: fireflies_create_soundbite - Create a soundbite clip from a meeting transcript
